name: Recurra
summary: Revenue analytics for a subscription SaaS: MRR bridge, churn, cohorts, plans and a forecast
about: A complete eight-page revenue analytics app for a software company that sells subscriptions. Every number comes from a simulated customer base, so changing a plan or cancelling an account moves MRR, churn and the charts. It has a graphite and lime dark theme, a paper light theme and sample data for a made-up cloud company.
how: Use 3M, 6M, 12M or All on Overview to morph the MRR chart and the KPI strip; step through months on the MRR bridge waterfall.
MRR movements shows new, expansion, contraction and churn as diverging bars. Click a month to open its bridge.
Cohorts switches between account and revenue retention on the heatmap; hover a cell for details.
Open a customer to see its MRR history and timeline, then change its plan, cancel it (with undo) or reactivate it.
Drag the Forecast sliders to project the next 12 months against your ARR goal.
Collapse the sidebar to a rail, search with Ctrl+K, and reset the demo data in Settings.
